provenance: GitHub issue #552, Roadmap ID M1-01, requested the 14 normalized QEC family targets.
GitHub issue #573, Roadmap ID M4-03, promotes available families after constructor and executable fixture coverage.
verification: cargo test -p qec-code --test family_catalog complete_catalog_has_12_supported_and_2_deferred_families -- --exact
cargo test -p qec-code --test family_catalog every_supported_family_has_positive_and_negative_cases -- --exact
cargo test -p qec-code --test family_catalog catalog_rejects_coverage_gaps -- --exact
cargo test -p qec-code --test family_catalog requested_and_construction_registries_are_disjoint_and_complete -- --exact

availability_promotion_gate.rule: Supported families become availability=available only when issue #573 verifies callable constructors and executable positive/negative fixture coverage; deferred families remain availability=not_applicable.
